text:
Dana: Quick thread 1: need a final decision on rerank billing when we do hedged routing. Product wants clear console numbers + quota safety.

Sam: My vote: quotas count what caller requested; billing charges actual evals done. Keeps tenants from gaming quotas.

Ivy: Agreed on billing=actual. For hedging we can either bill both replicas or dedupe. Dedupe is friendlier but needs coordination.

Sam: Can we do best-effort dedupe (shard-local cache) and mark it in telemetry? e.g., `dedupe_scope=local` and `dedupe_best_effort=true` when cross-rack misses.

Ivy: Yep. Telemetry keys: `rerank.requested_candidates`, `rerank.billed_candidates`, `rerank.dedupe_hits`, `rerank.dedupe_misses`. Also include `X-Redwood-Billing-Mode` header for opt-in raw billing.

Dana: UX ask for @frontend: show requested vs billed, and a dedupe credit line (requested - billed). Tooltip: explain dedupe and best-effort scope.

ops-bot: noted 1: will add dashboard ticket. Quick security note: allow `billing_mode=raw` only for tenants with billing-permission flag.

Sam: API snippet idea:
POST /v1/rerank
X-Redwood-Billing-Mode: dedupe
{ "candidates": 150 }
Response headers include: X-Redwood-Requested-Count, X-Redwood-Billed-Count, X-Redwood-Dedupe-Scope.

Ivy: Implementation: 500ms-1s TTL on dedupe keys, store sha1(request_nonce+cand_id). If cross-replica needed later, allow best-effort. I'll draft RFC for cache + gas limits.

Dana: Action items: Ivy RFC for dedupe; Sam docs + header; frontend mock for chart. Aim: beta internal next week.

Sam: +1. Thanks.
